title: corylus avellana f. variegata
intro: Corylus avellana f. variegata, commonly known as Variegated Hazel, is a variety of the Hazel tree, characterized by its attractive, mottled leaves. The health benefits of Variegated Hazel include its potential to help lower cholesterol levels and reduce inflammation. Its therapeutic actions include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, which may help protect against cell damage and promote overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Variegated Hazel include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other plant compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
